tasks.title: seed_playlist_module
tasks.description:
Create playchitect/core/seed_playlist.py. This is the core engine. It must make all tests in TASK-01, TASK-03, and TASK-04 pass.

Public API:
    generate_playlist_from_seed(
        seed_path: Path,
        candidate_features: dict[Path, IntensityFeatures],
        metadata_dict: dict[Path, TrackMetadata],
        target_duration_mins: float,
        *,
        genre: str | None = None,
        weight_overrides: WeightOverrides | None = None,
        tolerance: float = 0.1,
        sequence_mode: str = 'ramp',
    ) -> ClusterResult

Private helpers (used internally and tested via the public function):
    rank_by_similarity(seed_vec, candidates, *, genre, weight_overrides) -> list[tuple[Path, float]]
    fill_to_duration(ranked, metadata_dict, target_secs, tolerance, seed_path) -> list[Path]

Step-by-step algorithm for generate_playlist_from_seed:

1. VALIDATE inputs:
   - Raise ValueError('target_duration_mins must be positive') if target_duration_mins <= 0.
   - Raise ValueError('candidate_features must not be empty') if not candidate_features.
   - Raise ValueError('seed_path not found in candidate_features') if seed_path not in candidate_features.

2. BUILD 8-D VECTORS: for each path in candidate_features, call build_feature_vector(metadata_dict[path], candidate_features[path]) from playchitect.core.features. Skip (log warning) paths where build_feature_vector returns None. Store as candidates: dict[Path, np.ndarray].

3. GET SEED VECTOR: seed_vec = candidates[seed_path]. If seed_path not in candidates after step 2, raise ValueError.

4. SCALE + WEIGHT via rank_by_similarity:
   - Inside rank_by_similarity: build an (N, 8) matrix from all candidate vectors. Fit StandardScaler (from sklearn.preprocessing) on this matrix. Transform the matrix AND the seed vector using the fitted scaler (scaler.transform([[seed_vec]])[0]).
   - Call weighting.select_weights(X_scaled=scaled_matrix, genre=genre, weight_overrides=weight_overrides) from playchitect.core.weighting. This returns a WeightProfile with a .weights ndarray of shape (8,).
   - Apply weight_profile.weights: multiply each scaled vector element-wise by weights. Also multiply the scaled seed vector element-wise.
   - Compute Euclidean distance from the weighted seed vector to each weighted candidate vector: float(np.linalg.norm(weighted_candidate - weighted_seed)).
   - Return sorted list of (path, distance) tuples, nearest first.

5. FILL TO DURATION via fill_to_duration:
   - Always prepend seed_path to the result with distance 0.0 before the greedy loop — the seed is always first and always included.
   - Iterate ranked list. For each path (skipping paths with no metadata duration or duration <= 0), add to selected if cumulative_duration + track_duration <= target_secs * (1 + tolerance). Stop early if cumulative_duration already exceeds target_secs * (1 - tolerance) and tolerance is 0. If target longer than all tracks, return all tracks.
   - Return list[Path].

6. SEQUENCE the selected tracks using sequence_by_strategy(tracks=selected, features=candidate_features, strategy=sequence_mode, metadata=metadata_dict) from playchitect.core.sequencer. Valid sequence_mode values are: 'ramp', 'build', 'descent', 'alternating', 'bpm_asc', 'bpm_desc'. If sequence_mode not in this set, default to 'ramp' and log a warning. Note: sequence_by_strategy raises ValueError if a track is missing from features — all selected tracks come from candidate_features so this should not happen.

7. COMPUTE stats for ClusterResult:
   - bpm_values = [metadata_dict[p].bpm for p in sequenced_tracks if metadata_dict.get(p) and metadata_dict[p].bpm]
   - bpm_mean = float(np.mean(bpm_values)) if bpm_values else 0.0
   - bpm_std = float(np.std(bpm_values)) if bpm_values else 0.0
   - total_duration = sum(metadata_dict[p].duration or 0.0 for p in sequenced_tracks)
   - seed_title: metadata_dict.get(seed_path) and metadata_dict[seed_path].title or seed_path.stem
   - Store the name in the ClusterResult.genre field as f'Like: {seed_title}' (this is the only free-text label field).
   - centroid = scaled+weighted seed vector (a np.ndarray of shape (8,)).

8. RETURN ClusterResult(
       cluster_id='seed',
       tracks=sequenced_tracks,
       bpm_mean=bpm_mean,
       bpm_std=bpm_std,
       track_count=len(sequenced_tracks),
       total_duration=total_duration,
       genre=f'Like: {seed_title}',
       centroid=centroid,
   )

Imports needed: pathlib.Path, logging, numpy as np, sklearn.preprocessing.StandardScaler, playchitect.core.features.build_feature_vector, playchitect.core.clustering.ClusterResult, playchitect.core.intensity_analyzer.IntensityFeatures, playchitect.core.metadata_extractor.TrackMetadata, playchitect.core.sequencer.sequence_by_strategy, playchitect.core.weighting.select_weights, playchitect.utils.weight_config.WeightOverrides.

Add __all__ = ['generate_playlist_from_seed'] and a module docstring:
'Seed-based playlist generation: build a length-targeted playlist of tracks similar to a single seed track.'

Do NOT modify any existing files other than adding the import of build_feature_vector to playlist_builder.py (already done in TASK-02).

tasks.title: playlist_command_wiring
tasks.description:
Complete the body of the 'playlist' command in playchitect/cli/commands.py. Replace the stub body ('Playlist generation not yet implemented.') with the real implementation. This task makes tests 7–8 from TASK-05 pass.

Implementation steps inside the playlist() function body (after the duration > 0 validation):

1. SCAN library:
   scanner = AudioScanner()
   audio_files = scanner.scan_directory(music_dir)
   if not audio_files:
       click.echo(f'No audio files found in {music_dir}', err=True)
       raise SystemExit(1)

2. EXTRACT METADATA:
   click.echo(f'Analysing {len(audio_files)} tracks...')
   extractor = MetadataExtractor()
   metadata_dict = extractor.extract_batch(audio_files)

3. ANALYSE INTENSITY (uses JSON cache automatically):
   from playchitect.core.intensity_analyzer import IntensityAnalyzer
   analyzer = IntensityAnalyzer()
   intensity_dict = analyzer.analyze_batch(list(metadata_dict.keys()))

4. GENERATE PLAYLIST:
   from playchitect.core.seed_playlist import generate_playlist_from_seed
   try:
       result = generate_playlist_from_seed(
           seed_path=seed,
           candidate_features=intensity_dict,
           metadata_dict=metadata_dict,
           target_duration_mins=target_duration,
           genre=genre,
           sequence_mode=sequence_mode,
       )
   except ValueError as e:
       click.echo(f'Error: {e}', err=True)
       raise SystemExit(1)

5. DETERMINE output path:
   if output is None:
       output = music_dir / f'Like_{seed.stem}.m3u'
   output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

6. EXPORT:
   if output.suffix.lower() == '.cue':
       from playchitect.core.export import CUEExporter
       exporter = CUEExporter()
       exporter.export_cluster(result, output, metadata_dict)
   else:
       from playchitect.core.export import M3UExporter
       exporter = M3UExporter()
       exporter.export_cluster(result, output, metadata_dict)

7. PRINT SUMMARY:
   duration_mins = result.total_duration / 60
   click.echo(f'Created playlist: {output}')
   click.echo(f'  {result.track_count} tracks — {duration_mins:.1f} min')
   click.echo(f'  Sequence: {sequence_mode}')

Add imports at the top of commands.py (in the existing imports block): from playchitect.core.intensity_analyzer import IntensityAnalyzer; from playchitect.core.seed_playlist import generate_playlist_from_seed. The M3UExporter and CUEExporter are already imported in the file.

tasks.title: cli_reference_playlist_command
tasks.description:
Update docs/guide/cli-reference.md to document the new 'playlist' command. Read UPDATING_DOCS.md first to understand how VitePress pages are structured and whether the sidebar config in docs/.vitepress/config.ts needs updating.

Add a new top-level section '## playlist' to docs/guide/cli-reference.md after the existing 'scan' and 'info' sections.

Section content:

## playlist

Generate a playlist of tracks similar to a seed track, filled to a target length.

```
playchitect playlist --seed TRACK --music-dir DIR --duration MINS [OPTIONS]
```

### Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--seed` | Path | required | Path to the seed track. The seed is always included in the playlist. |
| `--music-dir` | Path | required | Music library directory to search for similar tracks. |
| `--duration` | float | required | Target playlist length in minutes (must be > 0). |
| `--output`, `-o` | Path | auto | Output file path (.m3u or .cue). Defaults to `<music-dir>/Like_<seed_stem>.m3u`. |
| `--sequence` | choice | `ramp` | Energy sequencing strategy: `ramp`, `build`, `descent`, `alternating`, `bpm_asc`, `bpm_desc`. |
| `--genre` | text | none | Genre hint for feature weighting: `techno`, `house`, `ambient`, `dnb`. |

### Example

```bash
# Generate 90 minutes of tracks similar to a seed, saved to ~/Music/Like_strings.m3u
uv run playchitect playlist \
  --seed ~/Music/Strings\ of\ Life.flac \
  --music-dir ~/Music \
  --duration 90

# Export as CUE sheet with a peak energy arc
uv run playchitect playlist \
  --seed ~/Music/seed.flac \
  --music-dir ~/Music \
  --duration 60 \
  --sequence peak \
  --output /tmp/myset.cue
```

### How it works

Playchitect extracts an 8-dimensional feature vector for each track (BPM + RMS energy + spectral brightness + sub-bass + kick + harmonics + percussiveness + onset strength), scales all vectors with a StandardScaler, applies genre-aware feature weights, then ranks candidates by weighted Euclidean distance from the seed. The closest tracks are greedily added until the target duration is reached (±10%). The resulting playlist is sequenced by the chosen energy strategy.

Also check docs/.vitepress/config.ts: if the cli-reference page is listed in the sidebar items array, no change is needed (the new section is within the existing page). If it is not listed, add it following the pattern of existing guide pages.

tasks.title: split_cluster_recluster
tasks.description: In playchitect/core/clustering.py, rewrite PlaylistClusterer.split_cluster (currently ~line 840). Current behaviour: rng.shuffle(cluster.tracks) then slices into target_size chunks and copies parent bpm_mean/bpm_std — producing indistinguishable random playlists with misleading stats (verified on the dark 4 library: 7 identical stat lines). New behaviour: (1) If feature data is available for the cluster's tracks (the intensity features used by cluster_by_features), re-run KMeans recursively inside the over-sized cluster with K = ceil(track_count / target_size) on the standardised feature matrix; each sub-cluster computes its OWN bpm_mean, bpm_std, total_duration, and feature_means from its member tracks. (2) If no feature data is available (BPM-only path), split deterministically by sorting tracks by rms_energy when available else BPM, then take contiguous slices — never random.
